env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

env CC=

env CGO_ENABLED=

cd fb

[cgo] logos build -o pure.bin ./pure
[cgo] exec ./pure.bin
[cgo] stdout '^pure-!cgo$'

[cgo] logos build -o real.bin ./real
[cgo] exec ./real.bin
[cgo] stdout '^real-!cgo$'

[cgo] env CGO_ENABLED=1
[cgo] logos build -o realcgo.bin ./real
[cgo] exec ./realcgo.bin
[cgo] stdout '^real-cgo: 42$'

cd ../fbf

[cgo] env CGO_ENABLED=1
[cgo] logos build -o real.bin ./real
[cgo] exec ./real.bin
[cgo] stdout '^real-!cgo$'

-- fb/go.mod --
module example.com/fb

go 1.27

-- fb/pure/main.lgo --
package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
	fmt.Println(Variant())
}

-- fb/pure/withcgo.lgo --
//go:build cgo

package main

// Variant reports which build variant was selected.
func Variant() string {
	return "pure-cgo"
}

-- fb/pure/nocgo.lgo --
//go:build !cgo

package main

// Variant reports which build variant was selected.
func Variant() string {
	return "pure-!cgo"
}

-- fb/real/main.lgo --
package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
	fmt.Println(Variant())
}

-- fb/real/withcgo.lgo --
//go:build cgo

package main

/*
int answer() { return 42; }
*/
import "C"

import "fmt"

// Variant reports which build variant was selected.
func Variant() string {
	return fmt.Sprintf("real-cgo: %d", int(C.answer()))
}

-- fb/real/nocgo.lgo --
//go:build !cgo

package main

// Variant reports which build variant was selected.
func Variant() string {
	return "real-!cgo"
}

-- fbf/go.mod --
module example.com/fbf

go 1.27

-- fbf/logos.toml --
[build]
cgo = "forbid"

-- fbf/real/main.lgo --
package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
	fmt.Println(Variant())
}

-- fbf/real/withcgo.lgo --
//go:build cgo

package main

/*
int answer() { return 42; }
*/
import "C"

import "fmt"

// Variant reports which build variant was selected.
func Variant() string {
	return fmt.Sprintf("real-cgo: %d", int(C.answer()))
}

-- fbf/real/nocgo.lgo --
//go:build !cgo

package main

// Variant reports which build variant was selected.
func Variant() string {
	return "real-!cgo"
}
